howto.name: Upload an Office document
howto.text: Select a Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), or PowerPoint (.pptx) file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Convert via LibreOffice
howto.text: The server uses LibreOffice in headless mode for high-fidelity conversion, preserving fonts, tables, charts, and layouts.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: Click Convert. The resulting PDF is ready within seconds for most documents.

faq.a: Word (.doc, .docx), Excel (.xls, .xlsx), PowerPoint (.ppt, .pptx), and OpenDocument formats (.odt, .ods, .odp).
Yes. The conversion uses LibreOffice, which preserves charts, images, tables, headers, footers, and most formatting accurately.
Most documents convert in 2-10 seconds. Large files with many images or complex layouts may take up to 30 seconds.
